_about: Intents the voice assistant recognises. 'examples' are typical ways people ask; 'keywords' are words or phrases that point strongly to the intent (weight 1 = hint, 3 = decisive). 'action' tells the main application what to do; the voice component never answers claim-specific questions itself. Add examples and keywords freely; run evaluate_intents.py after every change. Roman Urdu examples and keywords are matched by urdu_intent.normalize.roman_key. 'examples_en' are English ways of asking, used only by the meaning model (English mode).

guards._about: Checked after the score. 'noise': words speech recognition invents from noise or silence (it was trained on video subtitles) -> always 'unclear'. 'off_topic': everyday subjects that are not about the claim (a doctor's fee, a bus fare, the electricity bill) -> 'unclear', unless the sentence also has a claim word from 'anchors'. Safety and conversation intents ('exempt') are never blocked.
